definitions.gloss: prompt decision; snap judgment; deciding on the spot
definitions.explanation: Making a decision immediately without deliberation. Can be positive (decisive) or negative (hasty) depending on context.

examples.japanese: その{場|ば}で{即決|そっけつ}した。
{社長|しゃちょう}は{即決|そっけつ}タイプの{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: The company president is the type who makes quick decisions.

examples.japanese: この{物件|ぶっけん}は{人気|にんき}があるので、{即決|そっけつ}しないと{他|ほか}の{人|ひと}に{取|と}られてしまう。
examples.english: This property is popular, so if you don't decide right away, someone else will take it.

notes:
{即決|そっけつ} means making a decision immediately, on the spot. Composed of {即|そく} (immediately) + {決|けつ} (decide).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即決|そっけつ}する: to decide immediately
- {即決|そっけつ}{価格|かかく}: buy-it-now price (on auction sites)
- {即決|そっけつ}{裁判|さいばん}: summary trial (legal)
- その{場|ば}で{即決|そっけつ}: decide on the spot

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- Real estate: pressure to decide quickly on popular properties
- Online auctions: a fixed price for immediate purchase
- Business: a decisive leader who doesn't hesitate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {即断|そくだん}: snap judgment (nearly synonymous)
- {決断|けつだん}: decision, resolution (not necessarily quick)
- {迷|まよ}わず{決|き}める: to decide without hesitation
